result.summary: The home screen has several layout problems: category chips and restaurant cards are clipped at the edges, restaurant names and times overflow their cards, and a promo card is cut off at the bottom.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is cut off at the right edge, so users cannot see the full set of filters.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding or a fade/scroll affordance so all category chips are fully visible or clearly scrollable.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card (Trattoria Piccol) is clipped on the right, and its name is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal carousel enough inset/padding so the last visible card is not cut off mid-content.

issues.description: The delivery-time badge on Smash Bros Burgers overflows the image (the 'min' text sits outside the photo).
issues.suggestion: Constrain the badge within the image bounds and allow wrapping or a slightly smaller font so the full time range stays inside the card.

issues.description: The bottom promo card is cut off by the tab bar, so the restaurant name and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Notification badge on the bell sits slightly outside the circular button.
issues.suggestion: Nudge the badge inward so it stays fully on the icon background.
